body:
_Migrated from issue #1187, filed 2026-07-28._

On a phone, opening a book whose metadata contains one long unbroken string — a generated filename, an identifier, a URL — makes the whole book page scrollable sideways. The text runs off the right edge instead of wrapping, and every other row on the page stretches with it.

Caught while verifying #1166 against `cwn-local`. A book that had been left behind by an ingest test (`new_1_20260630_140053_206808_abcdefghijk`) reproduced it every time it was the first card in the grid; the page went from 375px to 1133px wide.

Measured on the offending element:

```
<dd class="_metaValue_..."> w=1038 white-space=normal max-width=none overflow-wrap=normal min-width=auto
```

`.metaValue` (`frontend/src/pages/BookDetail.module.css:500`) sets only font-size, color and margin. With `overflow-wrap: normal` a token with no break opportunity establishes a min-content width the definition list cannot shrink below, so it pushes the page out.

This is the same defect #1178 fixed for the book card's title / authors / series — the book detail page did not get the same treatment.

Not urgent for the shipped seed (no such title in a normal library), but any user with a long identifier or a filename-derived field hits it.
title: Book detail page scrolls sideways on mobile when a metadata value has no spaces
